messages.author: 5e649bb0b1e892e9
messages.subject: No annotation files found.
parts:
Dear Henrik

In directory "annotationData/chipTypes/Mapping250K_Sty" I have the
following files:

- Mapping250K_Sty snp info.txt
- Mapping250K_Sty,na24,HB20080214.ufl
- Mapping250K_Sty,na24,HB20080214.ugp
- Mapping250K_Sty.cdf
- Mapping250K_Sty.na24.annot.csv
- Mapping250k_Sty_genome_info_hg18.txt

However, I get the following output:

> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("TestSty250K", chipType="Mapping250K_Sty", verbose=T)
Defining AffymetrixCelSet from files...
Retrieved files: 6...
The chip type according to the path is: Mapping250K_Sty
Scanning CEL set for used chip types...
chipTypes
Mapping250K_Sty
6
Scanning CEL set for used chip types...done
All CEL files use the same chip type: Mapping250K_Sty
Retrieving the CDF for chip type 'Mapping250K_Sty' inferred from
path...
Retrieving the CDF for chip type 'Mapping250K_Sty' inferred from
path...done
Check compatibility with 1st CEL file...
Chip type: Mapping250K_Sty
Check compatibility with 1st CEL file...done
Updating the CDF for all files...
Updating the CDF for all files...done
Scanning for and applying annotation files...
No annotation files found.
Scanning for and applying annotation files...done
Retrieved files: 6...done
Defining AffymetrixCelSet from files...done

Can you tell me why I get the message: "No annotation files found"?

Best regards
Christian

> - Mapping250K_Sty,na24,HB20080214.ufl
> - Mapping250K_Sty,na24,HB20080214.ugp

> Defining AffymetrixCelSet from files...
> Retrieved files: 6...
> The chip type according to the path is: Mapping250K_Sty
> Scanning CEL set for used chip types...
> chipTypes
> Mapping250K_Sty
> 6

> All CEL files use the same chip type: Mapping250K_Sty
> Retrieving the CDF for chip type 'Mapping250K_Sty' inferred from
> path...
> Retrieving the CDF for chip type 'Mapping250K_Sty' inferred from
> path...done
> Check compatibility with 1st CEL file...
> Chip type: Mapping250K_Sty
> Check compatibility with 1st CEL file...done
> Updating the CDF for all files...
> Updating the CDF for all files...done
> Scanning for and applying annotation files...
> No annotation files found.
> Scanning for and applying annotation files...done
> Retrieved files: 6...done
> Defining AffymetrixCelSet from files...done
>
> Can you tell me why I get the message: "No annotation files found"?

In next version it will say "No [sample] annotation files found".
This is a not-yet-public feature that looks for sample-specific
annotation data at "tags" the files accordingly. In other words, in
your case nothing is wrong.

Don't forget to mention your sessionInfo().

/Henrik

>
> Best regards
> Christian
